summary: Tested Phase 2 of Daily Study Plan (ad-gated locking, premium full-unlock, next-week generation/append, week switcher, weekly-plan premium gate, daily item detail sheet). Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter16_daily_plan_phase2.py (11 tests, 10 passed/1 skipped due to generic quiz-endpoint auto-flow mismatch - compensated with direct-mongo seeding script /app/backend/tests/seed_fresh_roadmap.py + manual curl verification covering the skipped scenario). Verified via fresh free user: POST /roadmap/daily-plan/settings generates week0 with exactly first-2-study-days unlocked (locked:false, items populated) and remaining study days locked:true/items:[]/locked_count>0; free days unaffected. Verified premium user (via /api/premium/subscribe): regenerating settings returns ALL days locked:false with full items immediately. POST /roadmap/daily-plan/weeks/{i}/unlock correctly flips all days of that week to locked:false (verified via follow-up GET), is idempotent on repeat call, returns 404 for unknown week index. POST /roadmap/daily-plan/next-week: returns 400 with Polish 'Kolejny tydzień odblokuje się w sobotę...' message when not yet Saturday; succeeds (pending->ready) when generatable; a rapid second call while first still pending correctly returns {status:pending} without creating a duplicate week (verified weeks array has no duplicate indices after both resolve); new week is correctly APPENDED, old week(s) preserved in order. GET /roadmap/daily-plan includes next_status and can_generate_next consistent with the above in all cases tested. POST /roadmap/study-plan returns 403 with Polish 'Premium' message for free users, 202/pending for premium users; GET /roadmap/study-plan includes is_premium. GET /roadmap/daily-plan/items/{id}/resources: delegates byte-for-byte to GET /roadmap/tasks/{task_id}/resources when item has milestone_task_id; for generic items without milestone_task_id, generates fresh overview/steps/free_tips/resources with working urls and returns the IDENTICAL cached response on second call (no duplicate LLM call); unknown item_id returns 404. Frontend (Playwright 375x667): logged in as a freshly-seeded free user and verified locked-day cards render lock icon + 'Zablokowane · N punkt(y) do odblokowania' with NO item titles/descriptions leaked; 'Odblokuj resztę tygodnia za reklamę' button present, full ad intro(Reklama/gift icon)->playing(countdown)->thanks('Dziękujemy za obejrzenie reklamy!')->continue flow works end-to-end and reveals real item titles/descriptions for previously-locked days. Tapping the checkbox circle only toggles done (counter updated, no sheet opened); tapping the item row opens the AI-generated detail bottom sheet (overview/steps/resources rendered after LLM response). Weekly plan tab for free user shows the Premium upsell card ('Plan tygodniowy to funkcja Premium' + 'Przejdź na Premium' button), not the old create-plan button. Using seeded ania_t1 (free, 2 weeks): week-chip switcher ('Tydzień 1'/'Tydzień 2') renders and switching shows each week's own distinct days/items, both weeks preserved; next-week locked/pending/ready sections render correctly per isLastWeek+can_generate_next+next_status logic. Explicitly re-verified the previously-fixed regression: clicking 'Wygeneruj kolejny tydzień' immediately shows the 'Generowanie kolejnego tygodnia…' spinner (NOT the 'odblokuje się w sobotę' message) while next_status is pending, then reveals the new week chip once ready - confirmed NOT regressed.

minor.issue: Minor ordering edge-case (not reachable in normal flow, found via code review): the 'date.today() < week_unlock_day(last_start)' 400-check runs BEFORE the 'next_index already exists' no-op check. If a next week index were ever created out-of-band while the current last week's own Saturday hasn't passed yet, the endpoint would incorrectly 400 instead of returning the spec's intended {status:'ready'} no-op. Could not trigger this in practice since weeks are always generated sequentially gated by the same Saturday rule, but recommend swapping the order of the two checks for robustness.

action_items: Optional: reorder the two guard checks in generate_next_week (check next_index-already-exists before the week_unlock_day Saturday gate) for full spec fidelity on the rare out-of-band-race no-op case. Low priority, not user-facing today.
critical_code_review_comments: _serialize_daily_week correctly re-applies the premium override at read-time (bool(d.get('locked')) and not premium) rather than only at generation-time, so toggling premium on/off retroactively affects visibility without needing to regenerate the week - good defensive design.

run_daily_plan computes `locked` using study_pos (position among study days only, skipping free days) BEFORE incrementing, so the first FREE_UNLOCKED_STUDY_DAYS=2 study days (in weekday order) are unlocked regardless of which weekdays they fall on - matches spec intent precisely.

daily_item_resources delegating wholesale to task_resources(item['milestone_task_id'], user) for linked items is clean reuse; generic-item branch caches to the embedded item.resources field via array_filters update, consistent with the existing task.resources caching pattern.

create_study_plan's premium check (403) happens before the 'roadmap ready' check (400), so a free user with no roadmap at all still correctly gets 403 (Premium message takes precedence) which matches the explicit spec requirement.

success_rate.backend: 100% of executed assertions passed (10 pytest passed, 1 skipped+covered via manual curl/seed script instead), 0 failures
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested Phase 2 flows passed, 0 bugs found
